events.text: Root cause: guard Revert memcpy-restores model_paint positions directly, bypassing mesh_edit's mutation path — the welded unique-vert positions that drive the overlay dots/edges, gizmo pivot, and picking were never resynced, so they kept the stretched drag while the shaded mesh restored. Fix: new mesh_edit.refreshPositionsFromSoup() re-reads positions through the corner->vert weld map (topology/selection/scope survive), called from meshEditGuardResolve action 2.
